The '''Suurja system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region and contained [[Suurja]]&mdash;an [[Agriworld/Legends|agrarian]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that harbored both a native [[Species/Legends|species]] called [[Suurjan]]s and a colonist population of 16 million. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]], Suurja&mdash;the primary world of its [[Star/Legends|star]] system&mdash;served as a resource world for the nearby [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-covered]] planet of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. During the early phase of the [[Mandalorian Wars|conflict]] between the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], both sides [[First battle of Suurja|engaged]] [[Second battle of Suurja|in]] [[Third battle of Suurja|four]] [[Fourth battle of Suurja|devastating]] yet inconclusive battles on Suurja. In [[3964 BBY|3964]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], a large group of [[Revanchist|Jedi crusaders]] was [[Ambush on Suurja|captured]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] on Suurja. [[Time/Legends|Millennia]] later, the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Suurja system changed ownership between various governments such as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] successor states and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
The Suurja system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star/Legends|star]] system's primary [[Planet/Legends|world]] was [[Suurja]]&mdash;<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|300|Suurja}}</ref> an [[Agriworld/Legends|agrarian]] planet<ref name="Prime Edition" /> with a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that was breathable for members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="KotOR6">[[Knights of the Old Republic 6|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 6]]</ref>

==History==
The region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Suurja system was explored between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3996 BBY|3996]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> By [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]],<ref name="date3966">{{KOTORbackups|15}}, which is set concurrently with [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]] and thus in [[3963 BBY]], states that the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] began to threaten Suurja three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events depicted within the aforementioned media, thus the date [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]] can be derived.</ref> Suurja, the [[Star/Legends|star]] system's primary world,<ref name="CSWE" /> served as a resource world for [[Taris/Legends|Taris]],<ref name="Siege Edition" /> a nearby<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-covered]] planet.<ref name="KotORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> That year, the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]],<ref name="Siege Edition" /> who had been [[Mandalorian Wars|conquering]] independent planets beyond [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;controlled space for a [[Time/Legends|decade]],<ref name="TEA" /> began to threaten Suurja and other Tarisian resource worlds, causing the Republic to grant Taris membership and military protection.<ref name="Siege Edition" /> As a result, a Republic security cordon called the [[Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line]] was created, and the Suurja system was one of the systems that was located on the frontline.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[3965 BBY|following year]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces [[First battle of Suurja|engaged]] the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> in [[Second battle of Suurja|four]] [[Third battle of Suurja|inconclusive]] [[Fourth battle of Suurja|battles]] on Suurja in the span of six [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]. Following the fourth skirmish, the Mandalorian forces departed from the Suurja system.<ref name="Prime Edition" /> In [[3964 BBY]],<ref name="KotOR6" /> a large group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] affiliated with the [[Revanchist]] faction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Secret Journal">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/demagol/index.html?page=1|text="The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol"|int=The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol (article)|newhost=Suvudu}}, Entry #6062</ref> were [[Ambush on Suurja|ambushed]] and captured by Mandalorian forces<ref name="KotOR8">[[Knights of the Old Republic 8|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 8]]</ref> on Suurja.<ref name="KotOR6" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that erupted [[Time/Legends|millennia]] later, the Suurja system was located within Republic space. Following the fragmentation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the region of space containing the star system fell within the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Zsinj's Empire|domain]]. After Zsinj's [[Death/Legends|death]], the territory surrounding the Suurja system became a part of the [[Imperial Space]], and it remained within that region until the Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|defeat]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] campaigns against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the star system containing Suurja was located within the area controlled by the latter government,<ref name="EGtW" /> while by the year [[137 ABY]], the Suurja system fell within the borders of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Suurjans don't have ears.|[[Marn Hierogryph]]|<ref name="KotOR25" />}}
Suurja, the primary world of the Suurja system,<ref name="CSWE" /> was home to [[Suurjan]]s&mdash;a species that lacked ears.<ref name="KotOR25" /> The agrarian world also had a colonist population of 16 milllion.<ref name="Prime Edition" /> Many inhabitants of Suurja where forced to become [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] following the battles between the Republic and the Mandalorians that took place on the planet.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Suurja system was first mentioned in ''[[The Taris Holofeed: Prime Edition]]''&mdash;an article that was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published within the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion flip-book]] on [[March 1]], [[2006]]. In [[2008]], the star system was mentioned in Suurja's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published on [[2009]]&mdash;provided a map placement for Suurja and its star system, while the Atlas's [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] that was subsequently published on the [[StarWars.com|the official ''Star Wars'' website]] placed the Suurja system in the Ojoster [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
